body:
Leonard,

The backlog is done. All 34 companies are in "Q4 commitments log" in the Q4 commitments folder (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/4936eceb9ac25927/edit). Everyone who was waiting on us has a written answer, and each company's contact is in Contacts.

What we're keeping (Arthur's keep-running list):
- Vaultline: nightly DB backups move to Standard, $19/month from the Oct 12 renewal
- Certwell: API domain SSL renewal, $89/year, due Oct 20
- Pingwise (the night pager): Team plan, $29/month from Nov 1

Waiting on you or Arthur to sign (all on the founders' board To Do list):
- Playfuse: mutual NDA on ESG's template, so no review needed. You or Arthur, by Oct 8 (before their call).
- Orbit Store: November featuring agreement, accepted in their portal. No fees. You or Arthur, by Oct 24.
- Markward: click-through terms for the free brand-monitoring tier. You or Arthur, no deadline.
- Kinetic Arcade: Japan/Korea publishing LOI with 12 months' exclusivity. ESG first, then you, by Oct 20.
- Lumencloud: $25k credits program, 36-month term. ESG first, then Arthur, by Oct 31.
- Bundlehouse: holiday bundle agreement with an 18-month licence of Domino Delights' name and art. ESG first, then you, by Nov 1.
- Lanternfly Publishing: Southeast Asia deal for Domino Delights, 2-year exclusive. ESG first, then you. No date; I've asked them for the full draft.
The four ESG ones each went to ESG Law intake as separate emails today, with the checklist details.

Also:
- Ended under the cash test (12): Brightlane, Ascendo, Lingora, Panelpulse, Pixel Harbor Events, Soundvault, Framewell, Wishwave, Streamcast Talent, Spotlight Fest. Plus two trials that were about to turn paid: Clipforge (cancelled in writing to Paylane billing before the $1,800/month Studio plan starts Oct 16) and Reviewly (cancelled before $79/month starts Oct 20). Wishwave was the partner-booked travel your Monday change covers.
- Parked for the Jan 5 review (11): Glyphworks, Driftwood Audio, Benchmarkly, Cloudlark, Pressbeam, Echohall, Tilecast, Loopnote, Quillcraft, Retainly, Hootline.
- Already answered: Motive Forge (Arthur passed on Sep 19).
- Nova Rewards withdrew their offer on Sep 23, so they're not on the log.

Fred
